title: Onyx security mission catalog — final 2026-09-30
note: Descriptions are adapted from the September 30, 2026 catalog. All eight slots are planned learning studies. The catalog’s starter-recipe checks support preparation; they are not Ahmed’s independent achievements, completed missions or native product assurance.
publicationNote: Only sanitized material with appropriate publication permission belongs in this public portfolio. Suspected private findings stay in the applicable private disclosure channel.

evidenceKinds.label: Source / design
evidenceKinds.description: A pinned source trace or reviewed design; runtime behavior remains unverified.

evidenceKinds.label: Introduced fixture
evidenceKinds.description: An explicitly added synthetic exercise; conclusions apply to that fixture.

evidenceKinds.label: Native observation
evidenceKinds.description: An observation from the exact authorized product build, configuration and runtime.

evidenceKinds.label: Actual-model measurement
evidenceKinds.description: A measured experiment with a real identified model, known data and valid evaluation.

evidenceKinds.label: Authorized professional work
evidenceKinds.description: Actual scoped work with documented authorization, contribution and publication permission.
